questions.questionText: A clock seen in water reflection shows the time as 4:20. What is the actual real time?
options: 2:10 (or 1:10 depending on hour hand overlap)
questions.hint: Water clock formula: Subtract given time from 18:30 (or 17:90 if minutes > 30).
questions.explanation: Formula for Water Image of Clock: Subtract from 18:30. Here: 18:30 - 4:20 = 14:10 = 2:10.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Note that water reflection represents a horizontal mirror placed below the object.
Step 2: Top becomes Bottom, Bottom becomes Top.
Step 3: Left-to-right sequence remains unchanged (unlike mirror image).
questions.memoryTip: Mirror Image = Left-Right flip (sequence reverses). Water Image = Top-Bottom flip (sequence stays in order).
